video_caption: A young woman with long wavy blonde hair and dark brown lipstick, wearing a blue sleeveless top, speaks directly to the camera while making various hand gestures. Her expression is friendly and engaging. In the background, a white wall features a clear makeup organizer filled with lipsticks and bottles on the left, and a desk organizer with pens and a small green plant on the right. Two pink circular icons are displayed at the bottom of the screen: one with an Instagram camera logo and the text "@KAITLINEMMAX," and another with a Snapchat ghost logo and the text "@KAITLINDOSBSON." At 00:46, the scene transitions to an overhead shot of a white desk covered with a fan-shaped arrangement of colorful Pentel pens and handwritten notes. A white text overlay reads "< PENTEL PENS." The notes feature diagrams and colorful text, including one note with a pizza doodle and the word "SEGMENTATION," and another with a weekly study schedule. The camera then pans left at 00:51 to reveal a spiral-bound notebook with detailed, color-coded notes and diagrams, alongside more Pentel pens. At 00:56, the video transitions back to the young woman, who continues to speak to the camera, gesturing with a thumbs-up and pointing downwards, with the same background and on-screen text as before.

A young woman with long, wavy blonde hair and a blue sleeveless top speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands and making animated facial expressions. Her makeup includes dark lipstick and eye shadow. The scene then transitions to a top-down view of a white desk where a hand places a spiral-bound notebook, a colorful assortment of pens, and a black calculator, before picking up a purple pen and beginning to write in the notebook. The video cuts back to the woman, who continues to speak with an engaged expression and hand movements. A turquoise screen then appears, displaying the white cursive text "Tip Number" followed by a dark gray "2" (Tip Number 2), before transitioning back to the woman speaking to the camera, using expressive hand gestures.

A blonde woman with brown lipstick and a blue top speaks directly to the camera, with a white desk behind her holding makeup and other items. The scene then transitions to a close-up of a spiral-bound notebook held open by a hand with bright pink nail polish. The page displays "ESSAY PLANS" written in purple and green letters, respectively, surrounded by a pattern of colorful, wavy lines. In the blurred background, other pens are visible on the white desk.

The video segment features a young woman with long, wavy blonde hair, wearing a blue sleeveless top and dark lipstick, speaking directly to the camera. She uses animated hand gestures and facial expressions as she explains her preference for bullet points over mind maps for essay planning, finding mind maps too messy. At 0:31, the scene transitions to a close-up of a spiral-bound notebook displaying handwritten notes. The top of the page reads "Consumer Behaviour" and "Marketing Process" in cursive, followed by a circular diagram illustrating the marketing process with arrows and labels like "Understand Market + Customer needs & Wants," "Design a customer driven strategy," and "Construct a marketing program that delivers superior value." Below the diagram, there's a section titled "Understand Customer needs:" with blue bullet points such as "understand what they want (create value)" and "know how they make choices." Further down, under the heading "Influences" (in purple cursive), three hand-drawn icons (a person, a brain, and speech bubbles) accompany three columns: "Personal:" (with blue bullet points like "demographic," "situational"), "Psychological:" (with red bullet points like "personality," "self-concept," "perception," "Attitudes"), and "Social:" (with green bullet points like "roles," "reference groups," "Culture/subculture," "groups," "social class"). At 0:42, the video transitions back to the woman, who continues to elaborate on revision techniques, suggesting bullet points as an alternative for those who don't revisit their mind maps.

The video begins with a close-up shot of a person's hand, adorned with bright pink fingernail polish, holding a bouquet of colorful pens in various shades including brown, dark pink, red, blue, black, light blue, green, orange, and light green, against a blurry white desk background. The hand adjusts its grip, briefly showcasing more pens. The scene then transitions to a medium shot of a young woman with long, wavy blonde hair and dark plum-colored lipstick, wearing a blue sleeveless top, smiling and speaking directly to the camera. She is seated at a white desk in front of a white wall. To her left on the desk are a red candle, several perfume bottles, and a clear acrylic makeup organizer filled with lipsticks. To her right are a green potted plant and a container holding makeup brushes. Finally, the background changes to a solid light blue with white cursive text appearing, first spelling "Tip", then "Tip Number...".

The video opens with a young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a blue sleeveless top and dark lipstick, looking directly at the camera with an open-mouthed, expressive look as she speaks about using flashcards for revision. The scene then transitions to a close-up of a hand with pink nail polish holding a white flashcard. On the card, a hand-drawn pizza is depicted, with one slice separated from the rest, and the word "SEGMENTATION" is written next to it with an arrow pointing from the word to the separated slice, illustrating the concept of segmentation. The hand flips the card to reveal handwritten red text: "Segmentation - Why, Has, Requirements, Targeting- Strategies, Factors Used, Complexities, Position- Strategies, Sources, Examples". Following this, an overhead shot shows several white flashcards with various handwritten notes, including the "SEGMENTATION" card, and a collection of colorful pens on a white desk. The woman reappears, speaking to the camera and gesturing with her hands, then a pink screen displays the text "Tip Number... 6". The woman continues to speak, gesturing expressively, before a final transition to a light purple screen that shows "Tip Number... 7".

In the segment from 0:05 to 0:48, a young woman with long, wavy blonde hair and a nose ring is speaking directly to the camera. She has on noticeable dark lipstick and is wearing a blue sleeveless top. Her expressions are earnest, and she occasionally gestures with her hands to emphasize her points. Behind her, a white wall forms the backdrop, and a white desk is visible with various items. To her left, there's a clear acrylic organizer filled with lipsticks, a dark red candle in a glass holder, and a small perfume bottle. To her right, there's a white cylindrical container holding makeup brushes, a small green potted plant, and a decorative gold-toned item. A yellow sticky note is also visible on the wall behind her. At 0:48, the scene cuts to a solid light turquoise background, and white cursive text appears, forming "Tip Number... 8" (Tip Number... 8).

A young woman with long, wavy blonde hair and a nose piercing, wearing a blue top, speaks directly to the camera, gesturing frequently with her hands, which have bright pink painted nails. She has dark lipstick and noticeable eye makeup. Behind her is a white wall, and on a white desk to her left, there's a clear acrylic makeup organizer filled with lipsticks, a brown candle, and small bottles. To her right, there's a white container holding makeup brushes, a small green plant, and a golden decorative object. Several yellow notes are visible on the wall behind the plant. Throughout the segment, she maintains an animated expression, using hand movements, including interlocking her fingers at one point, to emphasize her words.

The video segment opens with a young blonde woman, wearing a denim sleeveless top and dark lipstick, speaking directly to the camera and gesturing with her hands. She has a nose piercing and full makeup. Behind her is a light-colored wall, with a white desk holding makeup organizers, brushes, a candle, and a small plant, indicating a beauty-themed setting. Her expression changes from engaged speaking to a more open-mouthed, almost surprised look before the scene cuts to a plain pink background. On this pink background, white cursive text appears, first reading "Tip." This quickly transitions to another pink background with the text changing to "Tip Number... 9," where "9" is a larger, dark gray, bold number.

A blonde woman with long, wavy hair and dark lipstick, wearing a blue sleeveless top, speaks directly to the camera and gestures with her hands as she explains her study habits. Behind her, a white desk holds various beauty products and a small green plant. The video then cuts to a close-up of her handwritten "Study Plan + Other Stuff" on a white sheet of paper, outlining tasks for "Wk 1" through "Wk 5," such as "Film testing vid," "Read All accounting notes," "Accounting finish notes," "Marketing essay plans," "Accounting pastpapers," and specific exam dates. Two yellow sticky notes are attached to the left, detailing "Absorption Costing" and "Variable Costing" concepts with lists of calculations like "op Stock," "production cost," "cost of sales," and "Net profit." The scene then transitions to an overhead view of the white desk where the woman’s hands are shown writing a daily task list for the week (Monday through Sunday) on a smaller notepad using colorful pens, detailing activities like "Accounting Wk 10," "Read 1 topic marketing," "Memorise flashcards," "EXAM 2:30PM," and "Entrepreneurship notes typed." She reappears briefly to continue speaking before the video returns to a shot showing both the multi-week study plan and the freshly written daily plan side-by-side on the desk, surrounded by the colorful pens. Finally, the woman reappears on screen, smiling and concluding her explanation.

A young woman with long, wavy blonde hair and dark lipstick, wearing a blue sleeveless top, speaks directly to the camera, gesticulating with her hands. She is positioned in front of a white wall, with a desk visible below. On the left side of the desk, a clear acrylic organizer holds various makeup items, alongside a red candle and a perfume bottle. On the right, a white pot contains makeup brushes, a small green plant, and a golden decorative object. A yellow sticky note is visible on the wall behind her. The scene then transitions to a solid pink background with white cursive text that reads "Tip Num," which quickly changes to "Tip Number.. 10," with the number "10" appearing larger and in a darker gray with a white outline. The video then transitions back to the woman in the same setting and pose, continuing to speak and use hand gestures.

A young blonde woman with curly hair, wearing a blue sleeveless top, dark lipstick, and a nose ring, speaks directly to the camera. She begins with her hands clasped in front of her, then uses animated gestures to emphasize her points. The background features a white desk with various beauty products, including a red candle, perfume, and a clear makeup organizer filled with lipsticks on the left, and a white cup holding makeup brushes and a small green plant on the right. A yellow sticky note is visible on the white wall behind her.
